REAL SHELL FIXTURE · G5 ONLY

Contextual comments, without losing your place

Keep your attention on the document.

Select a sentence and choose the comment action, or focus a control and press Ctrl+Alt+M. Try Enter, Shift+Enter and Escape. Saved highlights open an aligned card on wide screens; open Feedback to use the shared inventory on phones.

Focus the comment field to inspect the space between its outline and keyboard hints. Saved cards expose Edit and Delete icons directly; Delete still asks for confirmation, and Cancel returns to the trash icon.

Selection and keyboard review

Switch between Review and Changes without losing your draft. A good review explains what should change and why it matters to the reader.

This second paragraph is a new target. A nonempty draft is saved before retargeting; a failed request keeps the original draft.

Expand authored content

These native controls belong to the reviewed document, not the shell.

Nested scroll area

Select the nested paragraph, open a comment, then scroll this panel. Use Back to selection when it leaves view.

The nested selection should keep its excerpt and draft while the surrounding panel scrolls.

The end of this panel offers another meaningful selection target.

Long-document review

Scroll back to a saved highlight. Edit its comment, open Feedback, then close the panel: the text and selection should follow the same edit owner.

Last section

A comment near the end of a document must stay visible and usable, including at narrow widths.
